diagnostic_cause_evidence_detail.unresolved_overlap_policy: UNRESOLVED_GEOMETRIC_MISMATCH is supported only by frozen-contact events lacking an authoritative contact step/link; it does not overwrite rows quantitatively attributed to another diagnostic cause

exact_contact_event_diagnostic.population: all frozen transitions with resolved exact contact step/link

multi_origin.population: persisted heldout contact-classification mismatch rows only

single_origin.population: persisted heldout contact-classification mismatch rows only

limitations: actual current and successor trajectories are true-future upper-bound evidence
range support is the predecessor's frozen 0.10 m same-object witness definition
dense support copies exact primitive clearance when the exact critical patch is visible
finite scans use nearest point-to-primitive clearance and can differ from exact patch clearance
a global-threshold mismatch is descriptive and does not identify a valid per-link threshold
simulated contact and analytical clearance conventions are not physical severity measures
no diagnostic cause defines, narrows, or removes a protected-contact requirement
